verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Factory can take delegated tasks from Linear or Jira ('investigate, implement, and test the work'), review diffs and merge them, run headless via droid exec in CI, and review existing PRs. None of it documents configuring an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes. PR code review is a different capability, and droid exec in CI is only a building block a developer could script around, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes
